newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 23.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The Shanghai Stock Exchange begins to check changes to members' institutional structure.
- China sets up a common property rights exchange market along the Yangtze River delta with 10 member cities, mainly from east China, joining to liquidate the idle state assets.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China's State Assets Administrative Bureau mulls the liquidation of 130 billion yuan in idle assets owned by administration departments and non-profit-oriented units.
- Shanghai technology exports hit $320 million in the first half of 1997, up 28 percent compared with the same 1996 period.
